title: MAF Unforeseen
description: Ultra optimised modpack with expanded survival, creative and exploration
body:
**MAF Unforeseen**
-
is a modified version of my optimized vanilla modpack. MAFU aims to enrichen the vanilla experience, surpassing your typical vanilla+ modpacks while staying withing the boundaries of minecraft style.

**Performance**
-
Based off of my MAF modpack, expect top notch performance.

**Features**
-
- Improved structures
- More building blocks
- Crafting table tweaks
- Minimap
- World map
- Customisable F3 menu\
**You can also find lots of optifine/forge features here, including:**
- Ingame Zoom
- Mod Settings
- Dynamic Lights
- Increased Render Distance\
And many more.
